law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2010, as amended through Official Gazette 27/2016)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous works: 70 years from publication)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of exceptions incl. private copying with single equitable remuneration levied on recording devices/media and photocopying (art. 48(1); Government decision of 2011)
enforcement_body: Ministry of Culture (Normative and Administrative Affairs, Copyright and Related Rights)
